verdict.rationale: Zoho CRM's built-in assistant Zia is documented as creating modules, reports, and workflows, retrieving requested data, and turning images into Canvas views. Zoho also describes built-in AI agents (Zia Agent Studio and Agent Store) that execute tasks on the user's behalf, which squarely matches delegating tasks to an in-product assistant. missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on how users delegate tasks conversationally (scope, limits, approvals), and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond marketing-page claims.
